records.jp: 勇希、あれ……！
records.en_original: Yuki, that's...!
records.en: Yuki, that's...!

records.jp: 記憶の欠片だ……
records.en_original: A memory shard...
records.en: A memory shard...

records.jp: ただいまー
records.en_original: We're home!
records.en: We're home!

records.jp: おかえり～～～！　待ちくたびれたよ！
records.en_original: Finally! I've been waiting forever!
records.en: Finally! I've been waiting forever!

records.jp: そんな文句言わないで。<CR>食材いっぱい取ってきたから
records.en_original: Oh, quit complaining. We've brought lots of ingredients.
records.en: Don't complain like that.<CR>We brought back lots of ingredients.

records.jp: やったー！　今日はごちそうだ！
records.en_original: Yaaaay! Tonight we feast!
records.en: Yaaaay! Tonight we feast!

records.jp: この記憶は……
records.en_original: This memory...
records.en: This memory...

records.jp: この世界……雫世界に来てからの記憶だ……
records.en_original: It's from after I came to Oasis...
records.en: This world... It's a memory from after I came here...

records.jp: そうだ、あたしたちも作ろうよ！　秘密基地とか！
records.en_original: Ooh, I know! Let's make our own secret hideout!
records.en: Ooh, I know! Let's make our own secret hideout!

records.jp: へ？
records.en_original: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: 学校にいろいろ建ててさ、遊園地みたいにしようよ！<CR>時間はたっぷりあるんだし！
records.en_original: We can build things all over the school and make it into our own little theme park! We've got nothing but time, right?
records.en: Let's build all sorts of things around the school and make it like an amusement park!<CR>We've got plenty of time!

records.jp: 学校魔改造計画だ！！！
records.en_original: Let's form an extreme school makeover planning committee!
records.en: It's the Extreme School Makeover Project!!!

records.jp: な、何それ……
records.en_original: Th-that's a little...
records.en: Th-that's a little...

records.jp: 面白そうじゃん！　やろうよ！
records.en_original: That sounds awesome! Let's do it!
records.en: That sounds awesome! Let's do it!

records.jp: ……色が鮮やかだね。<CR>いつもはもっと暗い感じなのに
records.en_original: The colors are so vibrant...
records.en: ...The colors are vivid.<CR>Usually it feels much darker.

records.jp: 真新しい記憶だから……なのかな……
records.en_original: Maybe it's because it's a new memory.
records.en: Maybe it's because it's a new memory.

records.jp: ……前に勇希のココロトープに入ったときも<CR>思ったけどさ
records.en_original: Ever since we came here the first time, I've been thinking...
records.en: ...I thought this the last time we entered Yuki's Heartscape too,<CR>but...

records.jp: 勇希は、この世界に来てからどんどん<CR>大切な思い出が増えていったんだね
records.en_original: You've really made a lot of important memories since we all came to this world.
records.en: Since coming to this world, Yuki,<CR>you've gained more and more precious memories.

records.jp: そして、その分だけ想いもたくさん生まれた……<CR>これって、心が生きてるってことだよね
records.en_original: So some part of you has to be alive if you're still feeling emotions so strongly, right?
records.en: And just as many feelings were born from them...<CR>That means your heart is alive, doesn't it?

records.en_original: Huh...?
records.en: Huh...?

records.jp: 生きてる……？　あたしが……？
records.en_original: Alive...? Me...?
records.en: Alive...? Me...?

records.jp: ダメだよ……
records.en_original: Don't...
records.en: Don't...

records.jp: なっ！？　これって……！
records.en_original: Th-that was...!
records.en: Th-that was...!

records.jp: 多くを求めるのはいけないこと……<CR>あたしには伶那だけいれば十分……そうでしょ？
records.en_original: It's not good to ask too much. All I need is Rena... Right?
records.en: It's wrong to ask for too much...<CR>Rena alone should be enough for me... right?

records.jp: だって、大切なものが増えたとしても、<CR>それはいつか必ず失われるんだ
records.en_original: The more I care about, the more I have to lose.
records.en: Because even if the number of precious things increases,<CR>one day they will all inevitably be lost.

records.jp: だから諦めよう？<CR>……全部全部、諦めよう？
records.en_original: So... Let's just give up. Give it all up.
records.en: So let's give up, okay?<CR>...Let's give up on absolutely everything.

records.jp: ……っ！　嫌だよぉ！
records.en_original: No! I don't want that!
records.en: No! I don't want that!

records.jp: 諦めたくなんかないっ！<CR>あたしは……あたしはっ……！
records.en_original: I don't want to give up! I...
records.en: I don't want to give up!<CR>I... I...!

records.jp: あたしは……愛央とずっと友達でいたい！
records.en_original: I want to be friends with Ao forever!
records.en: I... want to be friends with Ao forever!

records.jp: みんなとも、もっと一緒に過ごしたい！<CR>たくさんできた、大切なもの……失いたくない！
records.en_original: I want to stay with everyone! I don't want to lose the people who are most important to me!
records.en: I want to spend more time with everyone too!<CR>All the precious things I've gained... I don't want to lose them!

records.jp: 勇希……っ
records.en_original: Yuki...
records.en: Yuki...

records.jp: ああ……あたし……<CR>やっぱり欲張りになっちゃってる
records.en_original: Ahh... See? I told you I was getting greedy.
records.en: Ahh... I...<CR>I really have gotten greedy.

records.jp: 苦しい……心が、ずっと痛い……。<CR>どうして……あたしだけがこんな……
records.en_original: It hurts... It hurts so much... Why did this have to happen to me?
records.en: It hurts... My heart has hurt all this time...<CR>Why... Why am I the only one who has to...

records.jp: ……ごめんね。勇希がこんなに苦しんでるのに、<CR>私にはこれくらいしかできなくて
records.en_original: I'm sorry, Yuki. This is all I can do to help.
records.en: ...I'm sorry. Even though you're suffering this much, Yuki,<CR>this is all I can do.

records.jp: でも……そんな私でいいなら……<CR>もし勇希がいいって言ってくれるなら……
records.en_original: But... If you'll have me...
records.en: But... if someone like me is enough...<CR>if you can say you're okay with me...

records.jp: 私と勇希は、ずっと友達だよ
records.en_original: I'll be your friend forever.
records.en: You and I will always be friends, Yuki.

records.en_original: Ao...
records.en: Ao...

records.jp: 大切な友達が……
records.en_original: Well...
records.en: My precious friend...

records.jp: 親友の愛央が言うのなら、<CR>信じられる気がする
records.en_original: If my friend Ao says so, I think I can believe her.
records.en: If my best friend Ao says so,<CR>I feel like I can believe it.

records.jp: あたしは……この世界で生きてる。<CR>心を死なせて、我慢することなんかない
records.en_original: I'm alive in this world. I don't have to pretend otherwise.
records.en: I'm alive in this world.<CR>I don't have to kill my heart and endure everything.

records.jp: あたし、欲張りになるよ。<CR>やりたいこと、思いっきりやる
records.en_original: I'm going to be greedy. I'm going to enjoy myself as much as I can.
records.en: I'm going to be greedy.<CR>I'll do everything I want with all I've got.

records.jp: 全部は手に入らないかもしれない。<CR>失敗するかもしれない
records.en_original: I may not get everything I want. I may even lose some things or friends.
records.en: I may not get everything.<CR>I may fail.

records.jp: それでもいい。あたしは……諦めない。<CR>だってあたし、この世界で生きてるんだもん！
records.en_original: But that's okay. I'm not giving up. I mean—I'm alive! In this world, I'm alive!
records.en: That's okay. I... won't give up.<CR>Because I'm alive in this world!

records.jp: 勇希……今の、ホント……？
records.en_original: Yuki... Did you mean that?
records.en: Yuki... did you mean that?

records.jp: ……うん
records.en_original: Yeah.
records.en: Yeah.

records.jp: 時間かかっちゃったけど、もう決めた。<CR>大切なもの、いーっぱい増やしてやるんだから！
records.en_original: It took some time, but I've decided. I'm gonna keep on making memories!
records.en: It took me a while, but I've decided.<CR>I'm going to gain tons and tons more precious things!

records.jp: 勇希……うん！　いい感じじゃん！<CR>その調子でガンガンいこー！
records.en_original: Yeah...! I think that's great! And I'll be right there with you!
records.en: Yuki... yeah! That's the spirit!<CR>Keep charging ahead like that!

records.jp: おーっ！
records.en_original: Yeah!
records.en: Yeah!

records.jp: あっ、でも……あたしがこうなったのは<CR>愛央の影響だから、ちゃーんと責任取ってよね！
records.en_original: Oh, but... You better take responsibility for making me like this.
records.en: Ah, but... I turned out this way<CR>because of your influence, Ao, so take proper responsibility!

records.jp: えっ！？　責任！？
records.en_original: Huh? Responsibility?!
records.en: Huh? Responsibility?!

records.jp: ふふっ。やりたいこと、いっぱいあるんだ
records.en_original: Hehe. I have a loooot of things I want to try.
records.en: Hehe. There are lots of things I want to do.

records.jp: そうだなあ、まずはバンドとかやってみたいな！<CR>実はあたし、結構音楽好きだし。あとはねぇ……
records.en_original: Oooh! First we should make a band! I'm actually a pretty big music fan. Oh, also...
records.en: Let's see, first I want to try starting a band!<CR>I actually really like music. And then...

records.jp: （勇希……笑ってる）
records.en_original: (Yuki looks...happy.)
records.en: (Yuki... she's smiling.)

records.jp: （相変わらずヘトヘトな日々になりそうだけど……<CR>こうなったら、とことん付き合うよ、勇希）
records.en_original: (Looks like I won't be getting much rest with her around. But I'm happy to join you, Yuki.)
records.en: (Looks like my days will stay as exhausting as ever...<CR>but now that it's come to this, I'll stick with you all the way, Yuki.)
